The US national park system covers an enormous range of landscapes, from desert canyons to glacier-carved coastlines, and a handful of parks stand out even among that variety.

## Yellowstone

Yellowstone remains the classic choice, with geothermal features like Old Faithful sitting alongside some of the best wildlife viewing in the country.

## Zion

Zion's narrow canyons and switchback trails make it one of the most physically engaging parks to visit, and the shuttle system keeps traffic manageable even during peak season.

## Acadia

On the opposite coast, Acadia offers a quieter mix of granite peaks and rocky shoreline, with Cadillac Mountain drawing early risers hoping to catch the first sunrise in the continental US.

Booking timed-entry permits well in advance has become essential at the most popular parks, so building your itinerary around permit windows rather than the other way around will save real frustration.
